name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Unified all home screen widget sizes (compact, standard, wide, 4x2, 4x3, 5x2) to the Concept 2 Frosted Ice mockup layout.
Eliminated legacy split 2-pane and beige Heritage layouts so the widget always displays the full Frosted Ice template.
Added high-resolution Concept 2 Frosted Ice preview image and layout to the Android Widget Picker.
Fixed widget root padding so the Detroit Red Wings sweater ribbon sits completely flush with the top and side borders.
Restored exact responsive boundary thresholds for standings table visibility.
